description: Tracks product-building and design tool repositories from GitHub signals.

items.description: Bringing Astrid Tasks back from the dead

NEO Emacs (WIP): GPU powered Emacs written in Rust with a modern display engine. Aiming for modern design & multi-threaded Elisp, 10x performance, zero-pause concurrent GC and 100% Emacs compatibility.
Coco Super Intelligence: agent skills, slash commands and subagents for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex. One command installs them into the tool you already use.

All your computers and your phone, working as one desk. Screens, apps, files, clipboard, calls, texts, notifications, mouse and keyboard, shared between Mac, Windows, Linux and Android. Free and open source. No account, no cloud, and now no shared network needed.
The next-generation Markdown editor, with an AI writing assistant. Free and open source for macOS, Windows and Linux.

🐦 Native menu bar & tray app for macOS, Windows and Linux: track Codex, Claude Code and Grok quotas, resets, API-equivalent cost and local sessions, with multi-account and API relay switching | 原生 macOS、Windows、Linux 菜单栏与托盘应用，统一查看 Codex、Claude Code、Grok 额度、重置动态、API 等价成本与本机会话，支持多账号与中转 API 切换
The ultimate open-source Android gesture & one-hand navigation suite. An all-in-one OHO+ (One Hand Operation+), FooView & Quick Cursor alternative with offline OCR and Shizuku.
The control plane for your AI employees
Your Best Ai Seconed Brain! An evolvable, local-first AI workbench where agents, knowledge, and everyday work come together.

Your work, already underway. A personal AI assistant for your job: mail, chats and tickets become tasks, the agents you already use (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini) do the work, and nothing goes out until you approve. Open source, runs on your machine.
One AI agent, everywhere you work — terminal, desktop, mobile, and your chat apps. Rust core.

Native drag-and-drop shelf for Windows. Drag a file and it slides in: keep files, images, text and links at hand, or drop them on tiles to zip, convert, compress, OCR and upload. Rust + GPUI, no Electron or web engine.
轻笺 - 免费的书签、笔记与云文件管理平台，内置 AI 助手，支持跨设备同步｜Free bookmark, note and cloud file manager.
